desc: Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem. This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us. SHOULD YOU ACCEPT THIS CHALLENGE... We’re in an unbelievably exciting area of tech, fundamentally reshaping the cloud-native, modern virtualization, and AI infrastructure landscape. Here, you’ll lead with innovative thinking, grow alongside us, and work with some of the smartest minds in the industry. We’re looking for engineers passionate about system testing, distributed systems, Kubernetes, storage, modern virtualization, AI workloads, and automation. You’ll work on complex, real-world scenarios involving HA, resiliency, disaster recovery, scalability, and failure testing across large-scale Kubernetes environments. As enterprises modernize their infrastructure, containers, virtual machines, and AI/ML workloads are increasingly converging on Kubernetes. From traditional enterprise applications and VMs to GPU-accelerated AI training, inference, and data-intensive workloads, Kubernetes is rapidly becoming the common platform for running the next generation of applications. This role gives you the opportunity to test and influence how Portworx delivers enterprise-grade storage, data protection, availability, and resiliency across these workloads—including containerized applications, KubeVirt/OpenShift Virtualization VMs, and demanding AI/ML workloads running on Kubernetes. WHAT YOU WILL DO: Own system-level quality for Portworx Enterprise across Kubernetes, storage, and modern virtualization environments. Develop comprehensive test plans, test strategies, and automation for multiple concurrent product and feature releases. Build and maintain scalable automation test suites , with a strong focus on Golang-based automation and code quality. Drive validation of HA, resiliency, disaster recovery, upgrades, scale, and failure scenarios in large-scale Kubernetes environments. Identify functional and automation coverage gaps, assess risks early, and drive improvements to overall product quality . Collaborate with development, QE, and architecture teams across geographies to troubleshoot complex system-level issues and ensure timely releases. Ensure CI/CD pipelines and automation infrastructure effectively execute the required functional, regression and system test strategies. Strong programming and automation skills, preferably Golang , with Python experience also valuable. Strong debugging skills across Kubernetes, Linux, storage, virtualization . Ability to work on multiple concurrent product/feature releases . Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across geographically distributed teams. Ability to mentor engineers, conduct automation/code reviews. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS :  BS/MS with 8+ years of software testing/SDET experience , preferably involving distributed systems, infrastructure, storage, or virtualization. Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Kubernetes application lifecycle management. Experience working with VMWare/HyperV , K ubeVirt or Red Hat OpenShift Virtualization is highly desirable. Strong background in enterprise storage (file/block/Object) and Kubernetes persistent storage/CSI . Strong Golang and/or Python programming skills , with Golang preferred. Experience developing and maintaining automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines . Experience with Kubernetes platforms such as OpenShift, EKS, AKS, or GKE is a plus. Working experience with public clouds such as AWS., Azure and Google Cloud is preferable. Experience with tools such as Git, Jenkins/GitHub Actions, Jira, Confluence, X-ray is preferable.   WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US: Innovation : We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers. desc: Are you passionate about solving roadblocks & challenges faced by MSMEs in India? MSMEs contribute significantly to India’s total GDP. 90% of India’s ~$1 Trillion Retail Market is controlled by Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSMEs). Which means ~$900B worth of commerce flows through these ~60M MSMEs in the form of shops/kiosks/homes, scattered all over the country. We at Khatabook, have a vision to empower MSMEs and help them increase their incomes. We have built a product that brings efficiency in MSME operations by providing them easy to use tools to manage their receivables, inventory and billing which creates transparency in their cash flow. Within the Khatabook platform, we have also enabled the facility to take loans for their short term working capital needs for select Khatabook users that are displaying good credit behavior. Our app has been downloaded over 100 Million times with a monthly active user base of 8 Million+ which are adding 220 Million+ transactions with a transaction value of $18 Billion. Why work with us? People are our biggest asset! At Khatabook, every one of us is a dynamic superstar. We have carefully bred an ecosystem which hires nothing but incredibly and exceptionally talented people who can dream, collaborate, experiment, and break new ground. We’re a strong team that looks out for each other. Your role: We, at Khatabook, are looking for a passionate QA Engineer to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of our mobile and API products. You’ll be an integral part of the product lifecycle — from understanding features and writing test cases to identifying bugs and ensuring smooth releases. What would you do at Khatabook? Design and execute test cases for mobile applications (Android/iOS) and APIs. Perform functional, UI, regression, and negative testing for end-to-end product flows (e.g., OTP login, payments, search). Identify, document, and track bugs using tools like JIRA or Linear. Validate API responses, headers, and error codes using Postman or similar tools. Test app behavior under different network conditions (throttling, offline). Analyze crash logs, performance issues, and app compatibility across devices and OS versions. Collaborate with developers to debug production issues and suggest improvements. Contribute to test case documentation and regression suites. Support basic automation tasks (if applicable) and learn automation frameworks over time. What are we looking for? 3–4 years of experience in manual QA testing (mobile + API). Strong understanding of software testing methodologies and SDLC/STLC. Experience testing mobile apps on Android/iOS platforms. Hands-on experience with tools like Postman, Charles Proxy, ADB, and Android Studio. Familiarity with API concepts, HTTP methods, and JSON response validation. Basic understanding of test automation concepts (e.g., Appium, Selenium, Rest-Assured). Excellent analytical, debugging, and communication skills. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (preferred) . Nice to Have Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, mock servers, or API automation. Understanding of performance testing and app instrumentation. Ability to write simple code in Java/Python for small automation tasks.
